steps.text: Talk to Redbeard Frank by the pub to the north Port Sarim dock.
chat: 1. Ok, I will bring you some rum

steps.text: Travel to Karamja for 30 coins (talk to Seaman Thresnor, Seaman Lorris, or Captain Tobias on the south-west docks).
Head west to the Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers bar and buy one Karamjan rum for 30 coins. (Do not try to leave the island with the rum.)
Grab 10 Bananas from the nearby trees.
Talk to Luthas the banana farmer about the customs workers, then talk to him again to ask for a job.
chat: 2. That customs officer is annoying isn't she?
1. Could you offer me employment on your plantation?

steps.text: Place your rum in the crate outside, then right-click Fill to add the 10 bananas (the crate outside, not in the bedroom. Careful not to eat the bananas).
Talk to Luthas and get your payment from him.
Take the boat back to Port Sarim.
chat: 1. Can I journey on this ship?
2. Search away, I have nothing to hide.

steps.text: Take a white apron from the fishing store Gerrant's Fishy Business..
Talk to Wydin in the food store South of Gerrant's and get a job while wearing your white apron.
chat: 4. Well, can I get a job here?

steps.text: Search the crate with the banana on it to get the rum.
Give the rum to Redbeard Frank, he will give you a key.
chat: 1. Ok thanks, I'll go and get it.

steps.text: Go upstairs in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock and use your key on the chest in the room directly west. Read the pirate message.
If you didn't have a spade already, you can get one from the Estate agent's house on the south-west side of the park, right next to the study desk.
Dig in Falador park, kill the Gardener (or run away to despawn him).
Dig again to get a casket.
